decisions.reason: Because this articulated construction dumper builds directly on our established product and service base, our accumulated know-how and strong absorptive capacity make continued improvement and commercialization more likely than withdrawal.

As a close extension of our lifting-related offer with clear market validation through a major order and long-standing rental appeal, it fits knowledge we already possess and should remain in the range.

Although this compact underground mining loader is more distant from our established offer, the strong early operating results provide valuable learning data that our in-house R&D can use, so we keep it while recognizing a higher withdrawal risk than for closer products.
